scripts/delta-run.sh: the daily freshness pass up to the paid boundary: new titles' worklist and enrichment, then prints the commands that buy
scripts/embed-corpus-run.sh: a whole-corpus embed in segments, restarting den-embed between them so ONNX Runtime's arena cannot OOM the host
scripts/facts-run.sh: reruns the facts stage until no WDQS batch was skipped, which one attempt at the full corpus never manages
scripts/recluster-run.sh: the re-cluster report a person reads before a taxonomy bump; no timer runs it, so it is run by hand
scripts/v2/derive_doc_facts.py: doc-facts.json from an existing facts sidecar instead of ~770 SPARQL requests
pipeline/embed_docs.py: embeds `den stage embed --dump-docs` output on the serving box, behind the canary
pipeline/import_box_vectors.py: joins embed_docs.py's box output back into an index store finalize reads
scripts/v2/merge_classify_labels.py: folds a classification phase directory into labels-t02.json without losing a title
scripts/v2/embed_premise_v2.py: builds the premise vector blob, reusing only base vectors the live embedder reproduces byte for byte
scripts/build-premise-tags.py: rebuilds data/premise-tags-v1.json, the strings behind the v1 premise vectors, from the v1 tag batches; it reads labels-premise.json, it does not write it
pipeline/seed_genres_moods_curated.py: seeded data/genres-moods-curated.json, and re-derives the subgenres and moods of listed September titles (--keys)
pipeline/resume_combined_excluding.py: resumes a paid combined run with capacity exceptions quarantined to their own shard, which audit_combined_bundle.py then verifies
scripts/v2/assert_compliance.py: after any subagent LLM phase: proves from the batch files on disk that no TMDB prose reached a model (TMDb 1.C)
scripts/v2/build_premise_worklist.py: premise-tag generation (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 13): which titles are sent, and the evidence they are shown
scripts/v2/validate_premise_batch.py: premise-tag generation: rejects a batch whose key set or tags are corrupt
scripts/v2/build_premise_backfill.py: premise-tag generation: re-batches the titles a pass dropped
scripts/v2/merge_premise_tags.py: premise-tag generation: folds a run into data/premise-tags-v2.json
scripts/v2/llm_phase.py: resume and coverage for any subagent LLM phase (--list-missing, --verify)
scripts/v2/movielens_pairs.py: builds the co-rating ruler's cases (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 9)
scripts/v2/score_reco.py: scores index arms on the co-rating ruler (oxyc/den-dataset#18 steps 9 and 12)
scripts/v2/premise_mine_candidates.py: premise ruler: candidate pools for triplet generation (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 12)
scripts/v2/build_judge_batches.py: premise ruler: the blind judging passes; pass 3 is unrun (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 12)
scripts/v2/consolidate_triplets.py: premise ruler: un-blinds the judging passes into the confirmed triplet set (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 12)
scripts/v2/score_triplets.py: scores index arms on the premise ruler (oxyc/den-dataset#18 steps 8 and 12)
scripts/v2/paired_triplets.py: McNemar between two arms on the premise ruler, the gate a new index must pass (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 8)
scripts/v2/build_bakeoff.py: the tagging bake-off's arms (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 12, postponed)
scripts/v2/build_tag_batches.py: tagging batches for the v1-vs-v2 bake-off (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 12, postponed)
scripts/v2/aggregate_tags.py: aggregates the bake-off's tagging passes into one tag set per title (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 12)
scripts/v2/drift_report.py: measures the bake-off's cross-batch vocabulary drift (oxyc/den-dataset#18 step 12)
